The read_only_catalog lists declarations already loaded by the runtime. Reference their names; do not emit them again. Their implementations are deliberately omitted because this is a local patch, not a request to regenerate the accepted program or fee tables. For each selected proper legal residual, assign its existing b_name to the actual Boolean expression. You may add current public numeric/string literal assignments with exact # sN evidence, observations with explicit entity/entity_source/predicate/predicate_source, proper residuals, helper expressions and source-decorated @rule/@scope functions. No query declaration: the runtime preserves the accepted query and all earlier rule/scope definitions. Never redefine existing inputs or rules, assign guessed truth to legal conditions, or return a native answer. Legal thresholds and dates are expressions using grounded public inputs, never factual truth requests. Use ordinary arithmetic/comparisons, and/or/not and conditional expressions; no imports, loops, tools or arbitrary calls. Additional declarations must use the supplied source units. If a selected legal subexpression cannot be translated, leave it unchanged by omitting its replacement; missing semantics stay unresolved. Only factual_observations may contain current factual truth, with exact evidence or null when unsupported.
